title.zh: Binance Faces EU Regulatory Probe Over Alleged Misuse of 'Reverse Solicitation' Exemption
title.en: Binance Faces EU Regulatory Probe Over Alleged Misuse of 'Reverse Solicitation' Exemption

current_state.zh: EU authorities are investigating Binance over allegations that it improperly relied on the 'reverse solicitation' exemption to serve European Union customers without full local authorization.
